items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: The name 'Saeed' appears only in the interviewer's question ('...Saeed? Where in the first place do you get your beat from?'). The interviewee does not mention Saeed in their response, nor does the context establish any personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee and Saeed.

ctx.x: I played a while on his drums because I didn't have any drums during them days. I used to use his drums like around the house and sometimes little small parties, you know, with a piano and drums. He told me when he wouldn't be using them. I'd use them sometimes. And like I said, I sent off to a music publisher in the house in the Willis and Music people and bought my first snare drum. And I bought my bass drum local.

I'm going to ask you, how you, how the drummer, what's the drummer's part in the New Orleans band, Saeed? Where in the first place do you get your beat from? How do you know the tempo that any number's going to be in?

The leaders explain it to you. Sometimes a man just pat his foot. Anybody leading a, could be a piano player. Sometimes they just pick up like that. Without telling you anything, you know, just like our outfit right now. Sometimes we just pick up. You just fall right in behind him. Some leaders have stomped their foot. If a man playing the sax or trumpet, he might tell you. Then sometimes, some numbers you're so familiar playing. If you just know the tempo, they're going to always play. Then you see, if it's…
